purpose: Record the hand fit of the relieved funnel-frame coupon in the printed front-top.
article: Front-right funnel-frame corner, with the production flange relief and print direction
result: Derek accepts the coupon's fit. It can sit slightly proud at first and seats under light hand pressure. The printed underside has some give.
derek: So that actually turned out pretty well. I think it's actually just about perfect.

As you can see in my first photo there, initially it looks like it might be sitting just a tiny bit too high, but get a little bit of pressure on it because that bottom surface is just a little bit soft.

photos.view: Coupon resting in the printed front-top before pressing
